name: default_tab
label: Default tab
hint: Id of the tab shown when the URL has no valid tab_id. Defaults to the first tab when empty or not found

name: tabs_json
label: Tabs (JSON)
hint: Replaces the built-in Overview, Assets and Performance tabs. Array of {"id", "label", "rows": [{"columns": [{"size": 1-12, "stretch": true to fill the row height (optional), "widgets": [{"id": "<widget id or sys_id>", "options": {}}]}]}]}

name: tab_list_label
label: Tab list label
hint: Screen reader name for the tab bar. Defaults to "Site views" when empty
